Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.util

Class MaterialBalancePvtHistory

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.util.MaterialBalancePvtHistory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class MaterialBalancePvtHistory extends Object implements Serializable
Pressure-aligned, explicitly attributed PVT handoff from independent laboratory calibration to measured history.

Records must be evaluated externally from the accepted tuned model along the declared path. This container validates alignment, numeric inputs and the common separator basis; it does not generate depletion PVT or prove that caller-supplied records reproduce the declared model/path. Such evidence belongs in the required path reference. Constant-composition tables are rejected for depletion-history matching. Injection that changes composition substantially still requires full compositional replay, even when represented by an externally evaluated path.

1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • MaterialBalancePvtHistory

      public MaterialBalancePvtHistory(CalibratedPvtModel model, MaterialBalancePvtHistory.Path path, String pathReference, double temperatureK, double[] separatorPressuresBara, double[] separatorTemperaturesK, BlackOilPVTTable.Record[] records)
      Freezes PVT records, their laboratory-calibrated model and separator/depletion provenance.
      Parameters:
      model - original/tuned model checkpoints with calibration provenance
      path - protocol used to evaluate the records
      pathReference - evaluation report, software revision and depletion/separator interpretation evidence
      temperatureK - isothermal reservoir temperature in K
      separatorPressuresBara - ordered separator stages ending at 1.01325 bara
      separatorTemperaturesK - stage temperatures ending at 288.15 K
      records - pressure-aligned Rs/Rv/Bo/Bg/Bw, including the initial reservoir state

  • Method Details

    • materialBalance

      public GeneralizedMaterialBalance materialBalance(double[] pressuresBara, double[] netOilSm3, double[] netGasSm3, double[] netWaterSm3, double[] influxM3, double[] expansionFraction)
      Constructs the existing generalized balance from a complete measured net-withdrawal history.
      Parameters:
      pressuresBara - measured average reservoir pressures including the initial state
      netOilSm3 - cumulative produced-minus-injected total surface oil from the initial state
      netGasSm3 - cumulative produced-minus-injected total surface gas from the initial state
      netWaterSm3 - cumulative produced-minus-injected surface water from the initial state
      influxM3 - known cumulative aquifer influx in reservoir m3, excluding injected water
      expansionFraction - rock/connate-water expansion fraction of initial hydrocarbon volume
      Returns:
      composable material-balance builder with no EOS or aquifer fitting
